title: Reconstructing the Human Development Index at the Individual Level from Survey Microdata: Development and Validation of a Methodology
abstract: arXiv:2610.35893v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This study proposes and validates a methodology for reconstructing the Human Development Index (HDI) from individual-level survey microdata, enabling disaggregated estimates for demographic subpopulations while maintaining coherence with the official HDI. Data from 40,185 respondents in 21 countries from the European Social Survey (ESS7, 2014) were analysed, combined with World Bank indicators for life expectancy, gross national income per capita, and expected years of schooling. The health dimension was estimated from national life expectancy, adjusted by self-rated health; income, by a lognormal multiplier calibrated by the Gini coefficient; and education, by combining observed and expected years of schooling. The dimensions were aggregated by geometric mean, weighted by sampling weights, with confidence intervals estimated via the delta method. translated_title: 基于调查微观数据在个体层面重构人类发展指数：一种方法的开发与验证
translated_abstract: 本研究提出并验证了一种从个体层面调查微观数据重构人类发展指数（HDI）的方法，能够在与官方HDI保持一致的同时，为人口学亚群体提供分组估计。研究分析了来自欧洲社会调查（ESS7，2014年）21个国家共40,185名受访者的数据，并结合世界银行关于预期寿命、人均国民总收入和预期受教育年限的指标。健康维度根据国家预期寿命并经自评健康调整后进行估计；收入维度通过经基尼系数校准的对数正态乘数进行估计；教育维度则结合观测受教育年限与预期受教育年限进行估计。各维度通过几何平均数进行聚合，按抽样权重加权，并采用增量法估计置信区间。在39,706名数据有效的个体中（占98.8%），重构的HDI显示出较高的……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本研究开发并验证了一种基于调查微观数据在个体层面重构人类发展指数的方法，可在与官方HDI保持一致的前提下，为不同人口学亚群体提供分组的HDI估计。
